provenance.asset_description: Uloa Su-Tae, artist Victor Pereira: Uloa Su-Tae is a lu-venon researcher, a quadrupedal marsupial alien species adapted to live in frigid temperatures, with dense fluffy fur. She wears a professional pink sweater and coat, a delicate silver headband, and a variety of bracelets and rings, and regards the viewer with cautious suspicion.
